description: Real public DICOM samples for viewer object-type and display-fidelity work. Data lives outside git under dataRoot/<id>/; rebuild with fetch-samples.py. references[] are DCMTK outputs (commands run from the case folder).

cases.feature: TID 1500 Measurement Report (Enhanced SR) with image and SEG references
cases.notes: QIN-Prostate-Repeatability. Enhanced SR, TID 1500 'Imaging Measurement Report' for the ADC series: per-lesion measurement groups (volume, ADC statistics) that reference the SEG segments (Referenced Segment) and the 20 ADC MR source images. The referenced SEG (BINARY, 80 frames) and the whole ADC MR series are included.

cases.feature: X-Ray Radiation Dose SR (CT dose, TID 10011)
cases.notes: COVID-19-NY-SBU. X-Ray Radiation Dose SR SOP 1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.88.67, TID 10011 CT Radiation Dose report (CT accumulated dose data, per-acquisition CTDIvol/DLP). The only dose SR in IDC. Dose SRs reference the procedure step, not images, so no image series is included.

cases.feature: Encapsulated CDA
cases.notes: No public Encapsulated CDA (1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.104.2) instance found.
cases.tried: IDC dicom_all SOP class census (none); GitHub code search for the SOP class UID and for *cda*.dcm files; pydicom, GDCM, dcm4che, fo-dicom, orthanc-tests, highdicom, itk-wasm test data; web search. One could be made with DCMTK cda2dcm/dcmencap from a public HL7 C-CDA sample, but that would be synthetic.

cases.feature: Segmentation: binary with referenced MR series, plus fractional with referenced CT
cases.notes: (1) PROSTATE-MRI-US-BIOPSY (IDC): two BINARY SEGs (prostate gland; lesion 1), 21 frames each, one per source slice, Derivation/Source Image references to the included 21-slice AX T2 MR series. (2) highdicom test data: seg_image_ct_true_fractional.dcm (FRACTIONAL, PROBABILITY, Maximum Fractional Value) and seg_image_ct_binary.dcm, both referencing the included highdicom ct_image.dcm.

cases.feature: RT Structure Set with referenced CT series
cases.notes: Pediatric-CT-SEG (IDC). RTSTRUCT (2.8 MB, many organ ROIs as CLOSED_PLANAR contours) whose Contour Image Sequence references all 42 slices of the included CT series (512x512, implicit VR).

cases.feature: Parametric Map
licence: MIT (pydicom/pydicom-data test data; see pydicom data/test_files/README.txt for each file's origin)
sopClass: VL Whole Slide Microscopy Image Storage
cases.notes: (1) TCGA-GBM (IDC): 'Aggressiveness Score Map' Parametric Map (float, 120x90, one frame) derived from a whole-slide image; it references base level instance ...1637519535681.8.0 (43 MB, not included). Included instead are three lower-resolution instances of that same slide series (levels .22.0 and .29.0, thumbnail .15.0), which share the Frame of Reference and Total Pixel Matrix geometry. (2) pydicom parametric_map_float.dcm (128x128 float, no referenced images). Both maps use Float Pixel Data (7FE0,0008) with a Real World Value Mapping; DCMTK dcm2img cannot render Float Pixel Data, so only dcmdump references exist for them (the slide levels have PNG renders).

cases.feature: Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State with referenced images
licence: GPL-3.0 (orthanc-tests repository Database/; file from a public issue report)
cases.notes: (1) RIDER Lung CT (IDC): two GSPS, each referencing one included CT slice: Softcopy VOI LUT (window -600/1200) and Displayed Area Selection (MAGNIFY with Presentation Pixel Magnification Ratio in one, SCALE TO FIT crop in the other). A Comprehensive SR 'Lesion Designator' references the first GSPS and its image. IDC GSPS have no graphic annotations. (2) orthanc-tests Issue168.dcm: GSPS from Lunit with Graphic Annotation Sequence (2 graphic objects, 4 text objects with CSS text style); its referenced image is not public, so it has no reference render. The dcmp2pgm references apply the GSPS VOI window; in these outputs the displayed-area crop/magnify is not visible (full 512x512 frame), so check displayed-area handling against the attribute values, not the PNG.
